## Interactive Labs {#interactive-labs}

<div class="lab-list">
<a href="live/playground/index.html"><strong>Node vs Center Playground</strong><span>No login, no session — adjust security, heterogeneity, and fairness settings and compare what one node sees to what the center sees.</span></a>
<a href="labs/aggregation/index.html"><strong>Aggregation Sandbox</strong><span>Compare sample-size, equal-site, quality-aware, and fairness weighting assumptions.</span></a>
<a href="labs/mri-domain-shift/index.html"><strong>MRI Domain Shift</strong><span>Explore intensity, contrast, noise, blur, bias-field, threshold, prevalence, and label-noise shifts.</span></a>
<a href="labs/personalization/index.html"><strong>Shared Versus Local</strong><span>Test partial-pooling intuition against mean-site and worst-site performance.</span></a>
<a href="labs/missing-modality/index.html"><strong>Missing Modality</strong><span>Toggle MRI, CT, EHR, pathology, and genomics availability across hospitals.</span></a>
<a href="labs/privacy-threat-model/index.html"><strong>Privacy Threat Surface</strong><span>Map information flow through updates, counts, logs, participants, and released models.</span></a>
<a href="labs/evaluation-shift/index.html"><strong>Hospital-Level Evaluation</strong><span>Stress-test per-site performance, calibration, unseen-site shift, uncertainty, and abstention.</span></a>
<a href="demo/heterogeneity.html"><strong>Heterogeneity Demo</strong><span>Standalone simulation showing why global averages can hide site-level failure.</span></a>
</div>

## Further Reading, Articles, Courses, and Lectures {#further-reading}

<div class="reading-section">
<h3>Start Here</h3>
<ul class="reading-list">
<li><a href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41746-020-00323-1">Rieke et al., 2020</a>: medical FL framed as collaboration for digital health.</li>
<li><a href="https://doi.org/10.1561/2200000083">Kairouz et al., 2021</a>: technical foundations and open problems.</li>
<li><a href="https://doi.org/10.1145/3501813">Antunes et al., 2022</a>: systematic healthcare FL architecture review.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="reading-section">
<h3>Medical Imaging and Clinical Evidence</h3>
<ul class="reading-list">
<li><a href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s42256-020-0186-1">Kaissis et al., 2020</a>: privacy-preserving machine learning for medical imaging.</li>
<li><a href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-022-33407-5">Pati et al., 2022</a>: large-scale glioblastoma federation across 71 sites.</li>
<li><a href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s42256-023-00652-2">Karargyris et al., 2023</a>: MedPerf and distributed medical AI benchmarking.</li>
<li><a href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41591-021-01506-3">Dayan et al., 2021</a>: COVID-19 oxygen prediction across institutions.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="reading-section">
<h3>Heterogeneity, Personalization, and Missing Modalities</h3>
<ul class="reading-list">
<li><a href="https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pmed.1002683">Zech et al., 2018</a>: site-level generalization failure in medical imaging.</li>
<li><a href="https://openreview.net/forum?id=6YEQUn0QICG">Li et al., 2021</a>: FedBN for feature-shift settings.</li>
<li><a href="https://doi.org/10.1093/jamia/ocad235">CODA, 2024</a>: distributed analysis and machine learning for health data networks.</li>
<li><a href="frontier.html">Research frontier map</a>: personalized, multimodal, foundation-model, evaluation, UQ, and governance directions.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="reading-section">
<h3>Privacy, Evaluation, and Governance</h3>
<ul class="reading-list">
<li><a href="https://doi.org/10.1109/SP.2017.41">Shokri et al., 2017</a>: membership inference attack vocabulary.</li>
<li><a href="https://doi.org/10.1145/3133956.3133982">Bonawitz et al., 2017</a>: secure aggregation systems framing.</li>
<li><a href="https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj-2023-078378">TRIPOD+AI, 2024</a>: reporting guidance for clinical prediction models.</li>
<li><a href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41746-025-01836-3">Eden et al., 2025</a>: governance themes for healthcare FL.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="reading-section">
<h3>Courses, Frameworks, and Tutorials</h3>
<ul class="reading-list">
<li><a href="https://flower.ai/docs/framework/main/en/tutorial-series-what-is-federated-learning.html">Flower tutorials</a>: approachable simulations and framework concepts.</li>
<li><a href="https://www.tensorflow.org/federated/tutorials/tutorials_overview">TensorFlow Federated tutorials</a>: research-oriented FL examples.</li>
<li><a href="https://nvflare.readthedocs.io/en/main/welcome.html">NVIDIA FLARE documentation</a>: production-oriented healthcare FL platform concepts.</li>
<li><a href="https://openfl.readthedocs.io/en/latest/">OpenFL documentation</a>: federated learning examples and deployment vocabulary.</li>
</ul>
</div>
